Disclaimer

We are committed to using appropriate security measures to protect the personal information of website visitors. However, our security measures are not guaranteed. We do not guarantee the privacy of any information that is communicated or transferred over the Internet. We exercise strong efforts to validate the material within this website or any linked website for accuracy, credibility, and reliability, but we cannot represent or guarantee the information to be exact or accurate. All medical-related information within this website is not intended to be a substitute for professional healthcare advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

Your Privacy

We uphold the privacy of users and website visitors and commit to obeying all applicable laws involving the release of personal information. There may be instances in which we utilize certain collected directory information to provide you with material about products, services, and other pertinent data that we believe may interest you. If you prefer not to receive this information, we will respect your wishes and remove your information from our lists or modify your existing information as you desire. You can trust that the data you send to us will be held in strict confidence and only used for business purposes. Personal data is never shared without permission or as required by law.

Our Use of Google Analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors engage with our website. Google Analytics collects data such as IP addresses, device type, geographic location, browsing patterns, and referral sources. This data is processed by Google and helps us analyze site traffic and improve user experience.

Google Analytics operates by using cookies and similar technologies to track interactions. These cookies store information about your site behavior, including which pages you visit, how long you spend on each page, and the links you click. Google may also use this data in accordance with its own Google Privacy Policy.

To further protect your privacy, we have implemented IP anonymization, ensuring that your full IP address is not stored or shared with Google.

Information Collected

We may send one or more cookies to your computer or other device when you first visit our website. Cookies help us understand visitor interactions, track preferences, and enhance user experience. If you prefer, you can choose to reset your browser and refuse cookies from our site or accept them individually to your device or computer. However, if you disable cookies, you may have limited access to some website features.

Our Use of Cookies

We may send one or more “cookies” to your computer or other device when you first visit a website. This is a small file that lets us know when you return to the site. The use of cookies allows us to continually modify and improve our website, as it reveals how often you visit as well as what information is most appealing to you. If you prefer, you can choose the option to reset your browser and refuse cookies from our site or accept them individually to your device or computer. If you disable cookies, however, you may find that you have limited use of our website features.

External Links

Some pages within this website are linked to third-party websites. We do not control and are not responsible for the content of these linked sites, nor have we necessarily reviewed them for accuracy. Third-party links do not denote endorsement or reliability of any service, information, or products offered on our site.

Policy Updates

At any time, we have the right to amend or modify this Privacy Statement. Please check this page periodically for updated privacy policies.
